package settings

import (
	"bytes"
	"errors"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"reflect"
	"sort"
	"testing"
)

func TestStoreContract(t *testing.T) {
	t.Run("successful save and load round trip", func(t *testing.T) {
		dir := t.TempDir()
		path := filepath.Join(dir, "settings.json")
		want := map[string]string{
			"quote\"key": "a \"quote\" and \\ slash",
			"multiline":  "first\nsecond\tthird",
			"unicode":    "雪 ☃ café",
			"empty":      "",
		}

		if err := Save(path, want, nil); err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("Save() error = %v", err)
		}
		got, err := Load(path)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("Load() error = %v", err)
		}
		if !reflect.DeepEqual(got, want) {
			t.Fatalf("Load() = %#v, want %#v", got, want)
		}
		raw, err := os.ReadFile(path)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("ReadFile() error = %v", err)
		}
		rendered, err := Render(want)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("Render() error = %v", err)
		}
		if !bytes.Equal(raw, rendered) {
			t.Fatalf("saved bytes = %q, want rendered bytes %q", raw, rendered)
		}
	})

	t.Run("callback failure preserves destination and removes temporary file", func(t *testing.T) {
		dir := t.TempDir()
		path := filepath.Join(dir, "settings.json")
		oldBytes := []byte(" {\"generation\":\"old\"} \n")
		if err := os.WriteFile(path, oldBytes, 0o600); err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("WriteFile() error = %v", err)
		}
		beforeNames := directoryNames(t, dir)
		sentinel := errors.New("stop before replacement")
		callbackReached := false
		var boundaryErr error

		err := Save(path, map[string]string{"generation": "new"}, func() error {
			callbackReached = true
			current, readErr := os.ReadFile(path)
			if readErr != nil {
				boundaryErr = readErr
			} else if !bytes.Equal(current, oldBytes) {
				boundaryErr = errors.New("destination changed before replacement")
			}
			loaded, loadErr := Load(path)
			if boundaryErr == nil && loadErr != nil {
				boundaryErr = loadErr
			}
			if boundaryErr == nil && !reflect.DeepEqual(loaded, map[string]string{"generation": "old"}) {
				boundaryErr = errors.New("destination was not readable as prior settings")
			}
			entries, listErr := os.ReadDir(dir)
			if boundaryErr == nil && listErr != nil {
				boundaryErr = listErr
			}
			known := make(map[string]bool, len(beforeNames))
			for _, name := range beforeNames {
				known[name] = true
			}
			preparedFileFound := false
			for _, entry := range entries {
				if !known[entry.Name()] && !entry.IsDir() {
					preparedFileFound = true
				}
			}
			if boundaryErr == nil && !preparedFileFound {
				boundaryErr = errors.New("no prepared temporary file in destination directory")
			}
			return sentinel
		})
		if !callbackReached {
			t.Fatal("beforeReplace callback was not reached")
		}
		if boundaryErr != nil {
			t.Fatalf("destination boundary check failed: %v", boundaryErr)
		}
		if !errors.Is(err, sentinel) {
			t.Fatalf("Save() error = %v, want errors.Is(error, sentinel)", err)
		}
		after, readErr := os.ReadFile(path)
		if readErr != nil {
			t.Fatalf("ReadFile() after failed Save error = %v", readErr)
		}
		if !bytes.Equal(after, oldBytes) {
			t.Fatalf("destination after failed Save = %q, want %q", after, oldBytes)
		}
		afterNames := directoryNames(t, dir)
		if !reflect.DeepEqual(afterNames, beforeNames) {
			t.Fatalf("directory entries after failed Save = %v, want %v", afterNames, beforeNames)
		}
	})

	t.Run("load rejects content rejected by parser", func(t *testing.T) {
		path := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "settings.json")
		if err := os.WriteFile(path, []byte(`{"duplicate":"one","duplicate":"two"}`), 0o600); err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("WriteFile() error = %v", err)
		}
		if _, err := Load(path); err == nil {
			t.Fatal("Load() succeeded for duplicate keys, want parser error")
		}
	})
}

func directoryNames(t *testing.T, dir string) []string {
	t.Helper()
	entries, err := os.ReadDir(dir)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("ReadDir(%q) error = %v", dir, err)
	}
	names := make([]string, len(entries))
	for i, entry := range entries {
		names[i] = entry.Name()
	}
	sort.Strings(names)
	return names
}
